attributes.name: Faithful Hound
attributes.powers: Display this card next to a location. While displayed, any character at that location may discard a card to add 2d4 to her combat check or to evade her encounter with a monster. When the location is closed, discard this card; if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish this card instead. Otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 14 check to recharge it instead of discarding it.
